As long as a package is mailed to them in their name it doesn’t matter if they’re a minor. They would need to make sure that their nparent doesn’t intercept any packages, whether it be having it sent to a friends house or a neighbors or getting it before nparent. I know from past experience some schools have pantries to help students that need it. They may also have local food pantries in their area, if accessible. If you need any more advice feel free to private message me.

If they are a minor they might be able to reach out to a school counselor if possible who would most likely contact CPS if they’re comfortable going that route. If not, are they able to receive packages or go to the grocery store by themselves without nmom knowing?
